description: This file defines the internal class GrainMigratabilityChecker, which determines whether grains are migratable based on their type and properties, utilizing caching and external dependencies like placement strategies and cluster manifest.

classes.name: StatusKey
classes.description: A record struct used as a key in the migratable statuses dictionary, combining GrainType and ImmovableKind for efficient lookups.

methods.name: IsMigratable
methods.description: Public method to determine if a grain type with a specific immovable kind is migratable, utilizing cache and fallback logic.

methods.name: IsMigratableRare
methods.description: Private helper method that performs the core logic of determining migratability, updating cache periodically.

methods.name: IsStatelessWorker
methods.description: Checks if the grain type uses StatelessWorkerPlacement strategy.

methods.name: IsImmovable
methods.description: Determines if a grain type is immovable based on its properties in the local manifest.
